Description
: Discover the natural allure of raw minerals with this 3-piece set featuring striking Amethyst, vibrant Green Fluorite, and rich Lepidolite stones. Each stone boasts a distinct color and texture, inviting collectors and enthusiasts alike to appreciate their unique beauty. The Amethyst displays classic purple crystal formations, while the Green Fluorite offers translucent green hues. The Lepidolite piece is easily recognized by its lilac-tinted purple and layered appearance. These stones are ideal for mineral collectors, educational displays, or as thoughtful gifts for those exploring the world of geology. With their rough-hewn surfaces and natural shapes, they provide a tactile and visually appealing addition to any display. The included clear plastic storage box ensures easy organization and display. Overall, these stones are in visible used condition, each displaying the variations and natural imperfections typical of unpolished minerals, making every piece distinct. Stones measure approximately 2-3 inches each. Ruler and container shown for size reference only; no additional items are included
NATURAL Rocks

282030996.description:
Item Description:
Polished Agate Geode Bookends (Brazil), Turquoise, White, Green, Black Exterior
A pair of polished natural agate geode slabs, made into bookends; could also be used as separate desk sculptures or paperweights. Have a crusty black/purplish exterior with what appears to be natural but may be dyed turquoise upper layer "skin" border, with a white and clear feathered crystalline inner structure. One piece shows the center ball like glittery ball like formations of the inner geode, surrounded by a creamy off white color. On the reverse side, the surface is a more mottled and striped sage green and other teal and green hues more matte polished stone. The narrow face shows a blocky rectangular pair of images symmetrically opposed with an white geode crystal interior and a t shaped turquoise border. The variety of visual perspectives and colors/textures contained within this pair of polished rocks slabs thus makes for a very interesting and useful decor item.
Manufacturer/Markings:
One item has a white sticker "Made in Brazil"
Dimensions (LxWxH):

White, clear, turquoise, purplish black, cream color, green, teal, blue
